title: Bacalhau Fritters
description: A traditional Portuguese dish made with crispy bacalhau fritters served with a side of warm sauce.
instructions: Soak the dried cod in water for 24 hours.
Drain and flake the cod into small pieces.
In a large bowl, mix together the flour, eggs, onion, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Add the flaked cod to the bowl and mix well.
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the cod mixture into the hot oil.
Fry the fritters until they are golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
Drain the fritters on paper towels and serve warm with a side of warm sauce.
